# Services Agreement

## 1 Definitions

"Services" means the services described in clause 2.
The supplier (the "Supplier") is named in Schedule 1.

## 2 Services

The Supplier provides the Services.

### 2.1 Scope

Scope is limited as set out in clauses 2 and 3. Clause 9 does not exist.
See [the fee table](#3-fees) and [the referenced PEP](pep-9002.rst#rationale).

## 3 Fees

Fees are in Schedule 1 and Appendix B, using the terms in the Definitions
section. Terms are at https://example.com/terms.

```text
clause 2.1 and https://example.com/code are code
```

Use `clause 1` literally.

## Schedule 1 Pricing

Prices for the Services.

## Appendix A Forms

Forms, per Part 2 of the Schedule.
